title: Establish the SvelteKit Operator PWA scaffold

gates.name: pwa_scaffold_smoke
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/pwa-scaffold.spec.ts

verify: Independent inspection and browser smoke prove one Svelte 5 Runes/TypeScript/SvelteKit stack, an installable static-shell PWA, and no protected-response cache or background mutation queue.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-001 RED: the current tree has no frontend scaffold or runnable Svelte check/build/installability surface; GREEN: one Svelte 5 Runes/TypeScript/SvelteKit scaffold passes check/build and static-shell-only PWA smoke; decisive comparison: dependency/config inspection plus executed commands and cache request log; artifact: scaffold report under .tasks/TASK-080-T2-FT-016-W1/.
purpose: Create the smallest executable frontend substrate required by every FT-016 presentation task without introducing domain behavior or a competing framework.
success_outcome: A local Svelte 5/SvelteKit PWA scaffold builds, checks, and installs with static-shell-only caching and the required Playwright command, while protected data and mutations remain uncached.
anti_goals: Do not implement Boss, Plant, provider, Dataset, or storage-prompt product behavior in the scaffold task.
Do not add a second frontend framework, legacy Svelte syntax, LAN/CORS mode, hosted deployment, background sync, or protected-response cache.

stop_conditions: The scaffold requires a non-Svelte frontend framework or a shared/global architecture change.
Installability would require caching protected API/SSR data or queueing mutations.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA under frontend/; code roots are advisory and not a hard write boundary.
Use Svelte 5 Runes, TypeScript, SvelteKit, server-safe browser API access, and the required validation loop.
invariants: The PWA is presentation only and has no backend authorization or mutable domain authority.
Service-worker behavior never stores protected Account/Plant responses or queues mutations.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-001: check/build/installability, exact dependency inspection, one framework, Runes-only project code, and protected-cache absence.
Operator PWA scaffold obligation: static application-shell caching only and no background sync.
